verdict.rationale: Shortcut is a SaaS project-management platform that stores customer workspace data, so a commitment or setting that keeps that data out of AI model training is a fair question to ask, and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an AI-training opt-out, a no-training policy, or any data-use control for model training. The closest items, "secure" data access and separate Workspaces for sensitive information, are adjacent features that do not address model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
